description: This file contains subtitle processing implementations, including functions for running quality checks and corrections, subtitle generation from video, translation, and validation. It serves as a core component for subtitle manipulation within a larger platform.

methods.name: str run_quality_check_and_correct( subtitle_path: str, video_path: Optional[str], language: Optional[str], enforce_ott: bool, processed_dir: str, )
methods.description: Performs basic checks and correction on a subtitle file by normalizing whitespace, timings, and capping number of lines per caption if enforced.

methods.name: str generate_subtitles_for_video( video_path: str, language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Simulates subtitle generation for a given video by creating placeholder SRT content.

methods.name: str translate_subtitles( subtitle_path: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Pretends to translate subtitles by appending language code tags to text lines, mimicking translation.

methods.name: List[str] validate_subtitles(subtitle_path: str, options: Dict)
methods.description: Performs basic validation on subtitles, checking character limits, caption length, and presence of text.
